terra.problem: Saying there is no one left standing, then picturing all the opponents leaving, suggests believers face no opposition. Paul's question does not say that.
It adds a significant belief to Papa Dorin's backstory: that he spent years thinking he had to earn his way out of the drawer.
On a false true-or-false card, the explanation must say what the text really says. It says Jesus is not condemning, but omits that He is interceding for us.
Saying these are things that happen to people, not things people do, overlooks that persecution is something people can do to others. The list describes hardships suffered.
Calling creation 'everything' without qualification goes beyond the text. God is not part of creation.
